the use of oil palm in Brazil is a good option to mitigate climate change and to improve rural income and employment, but it must be done in an integrated way with other land uses and with a careful planning of the whole system.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the economic viability of oil palm plantations in Brazil depends on the future price of oil, the price of carbon and the subsidies that are available for carbon sequestration.
the oil palm biodiesel production in the Amazon should be considered only if it is part of a larger strategy that includes the protection of the forest and other natural ecosystems.
